analysis.summary: A roadmap article on software security analysis for the coming decade. It asks what vulnerabilities future systems will have and how to detect them, how to find bugs once the shallow ones are gone, and how to protect systems when not all flaws can be found -- in a setting where code is increasingly co-written by generative AI and dependencies span whole supply chains.
